text:
kai: quick note  after the fallback routing change some tenants report requests billed to org even though keys are project-scoped. small % but noticeable on quota charts.

anya: can you confirm whether header or exchanged token is missing project claim?

kai: traced a few samples  original request has X-Redwood-Origin: org/999/project/555 but exchanged token from auth-service only contains org. edge preserved header.

mira: that's the compat-exchange path in auth-service. historically we stripped project to avoid model rejects for old runtimes.

sam: proposal: add telemetry labels `auth.exchange_preserved=true|false` and `routing.fallback_variant=primary|compat-legacy|cost-optim`. surface in quota UI as "Routing used: compat-legacy (project claim stripped)".

anya: also add a tenant-level opt-in flag `auth.preserve_project_claim=true` so we can canary with internal orgs. keep fallback to strip-on-reject behavior as safety.

mira: ops-bot: schedule canary toggle?

ops-bot: canary scheduled at 1798123400 for orgs [redwood-int-1, redwood-int-2] with flag `auth.preserve_project_claim=true`. monitoring: `auth.exchange_preserved` and `model_reject_rate`.

kai: telemetry retention note: store sanitized original_header for 48h to aid debug, legal approved.

sam: UX: add small tooltip on quota spike: "Some requests attributed to org because compat-legacy routing stripped project claim. Click to see traces." also an "Opt into strict project attribution" button for tenants.

mira: rollout checklist: 1) emit telemetry globally 2) canary preserve flag for internal orgs 3) measure model rejects and latency for 24h 4) if rejects <0.5% roll to more orgs 5) keep `auth.force_strip=true` for tenants who want org billing.

anya: owners: kai (telemetry query and dashboard), mira (auth patch and canary), sam (console UX copy). check back in 12h with heatmap.

kai: thanks all  will post first snapshot in this thread.
